{{wiki_emf_p1}}: A basic device for measuring electromagnetic fields. The EMF reader will detect paranormal activity and display its strength using the 5 corresponding LED lights. Device is silent.
{{wiki_emf_p2}}: Same functionality as the EMF-V Genereic EMF but includes a built-in speaker that will make noise when detecting EMF.
{{wiki_emf_cleanse}}: By measuring events, touched doors, and other items that have been interacted with, you can get the following readings:
{{wiki_emf_identify}}: Any reading that results in in a 20+ reading (all 5 lights lit) is considered EMF 20+ evidence.
{{wiki_temperature_p1}}: A digital thermometer that accurately and automatically measures the temperature of the surrounding environment. With a record of high and low temperatures, it makes it easy to leave the device in a room and check the temperature at a later time
{{wiki_temperature_p2}}: A laser thermometer allows you to measure the temperature of any object that it is pointed at. This allows your to measure adjacent rooms quickly and is precise enough to measure the temperature of a single object
{{wiki_temperature_p3}}: A wireless thermometer that can be placed in a room for easy viewing, but also transmits the data to the Phantom Detect app for remote monitoring
{{wiki_temperature_cleanse}}: Measuring the temperature of the ghost's favorite room and adjacent rooms can give you the following readings:
{{wiki_temperature_identify}}: Any reading that results in a temperature of 0°C/32°F or lower is considered Freezing evidence.
{{wiki_uv_p1}}: A classic glowstick that emits ultraviolet light. This allows you to quickly see any ultraviolet evidence that may be left behind. Intensity of the light and length it lasts decreases over time. This item will be discarded at the end of a contract if used
{{wiki_uv_p2}}: A UV flashlight that emits ultraviolet light. This allows you to quickly see any ultraviolet evidence that may be left behind. This item is kept between contracts
{{wiki_uv_cleanse}}: Using the UV light to find traces left behind by the ghost, you can find the following types of evidence:
{{wiki_uv_identify}}: Any UV evidence found is considered UV evidence.
{{wiki_writing_p1}}: A simple blank book that can be placed on a table or other flat surface. The ghost may write in the book, leaving behind evidence of its presence. If written in, simply pick up the book and replace it to leave another blank page for the ghost to write on
{{wiki_writing_p2}}: A easel with 4 blank sheets for the ghost to write on. Once all 4 sheets have been drawn on, simply pick up the easel and replace it to leave another 4 blank sheets for the ghost to write on
{{wiki_writing_level_1}}: Incomprehensible Scribbling: Chaotic or random scribbles with no discernible meaning
{{wiki_writing_cleanse}}: After placing the writing equipment near the ghost, the ghost can leave behind the following types of writing evidence:
{{wiki_writing_identify}}: Any writing evidence found is considered writing evidence.
{{wiki_audio_p1}}: A device that quickly scans through radio frequencies to allow the ghost to communicate with the player. The device will emit a static noise when turned on and will respond through the device.
{{wiki_audio_p2}}: A passive device that will record audio from the ghost in the ghost's favorite room. The indicator will flash yellow when audio has been recorded. Only works when placed in the ghost's favorite room
{{wiki_audio_level_1}}: Unintelligible Sounds: Random noises, groans, or sounds with no clear meaning
{{wiki_audio_level_2}}: Single Word Responses: Short, single-word responses that are clear and understandable
{{wiki_audio_level_3}}: Intelligible Phrases: Complete sentences that are coherent and understandable
{{wiki_audio_cleanse}}: When a ghost responds through the spirit box or is recorded by the audio recorder, it can give the following types of audio evidence:
{{wiki_audio_identify}}: Any audio evidence found is considered audio evidence.
{{wiki_radiation_p1}}: An analog device that measures the level of radiation in the surrounding environment. The device will emit a clicking sound when turned on and will respond with more frequent clicking sounds when radiation is detected along with a visual indicator on the device
{{wiki_radiation_p2}}: A digital device that measures the level of radiation in the surrounding environment. The device will emit a clicking sound when turned on and will respond with more frequent clicking sounds when radiation is detected along with a visual indicator on the device. This device also keeps track of the highest level of radiation detected during the contract
{{wiki_radiation_cleanse}}: When a ghost interacts with the radiation detector, it can leave behind the following types of radiation evidence:
{{wiki_radiation_identify}}: Any radiation evidence above 55 CPM is considered radiation evidence.
{{wiki_false_evidence_p1}}: In Identify mode, there is an option in some difficulties to have False Evidence. This is extra evidence that is given by the ghost (that they may not even have) to mislead the player.
{{wiki_false_evidence_p2}}:
False evidence can be determined by measuring evidence multiple times over the course of the investigation. If the level of the evidence decreases over the course of the round, it is false evidence.

For example: if you find a UV handprint on a door after it is touched, but then you find a UV splotch, that is a false evidence.
{{wiki_false_evidence_li1}}: A ghost may give its own evidence as fake evidence, so you will not want to rule out a ghost based on a false evidence.
{{wiki_false_evidence_li2}}: Ghosts with a forced/guaranteed evidence will never give that evidence as a false evidence.
{{wiki_false_evidence_li3}}: True evidence will remain at the same level or increase throughout the contract.
{{wiki_false_evidence_li4}}: Evidence does not need to start at the hightest level (with the exception of Audio), nor does it need to decrease more than one level
{{wiki_false_evidence_p4}}: Below is a list of evidences and an example of what each will progressively look like:
{{wiki_false_evidence_p5}}: Any audio level lower than level 3 will be false evidence.
{{wiki_sanitymeds_p1}}: A one time use medication that, when take, will increase the player's sanity (and decrease their BPM). May have small side effects impacting vision for a short time immediately after taking it
{{wiki_obsidianshield_p1}}: A blessed candle that, while lit, will protect any players within its range from the paranormal completely. The candle will burn for a limited time and will need to be replaced after it is used
{{wiki_holywater_p1}}: A spray bottle full of holy water. Allows the player to spray holy water on a ghost to temporarily stun it. Each bottle has a limited amount of holy water and will need to be replaced after it is fully used
{{wiki_light_p1}}: Your generic flashlight. Can be used to light up dark areas
{{wiki_crux_p1}}: A cross that can be used to confirm the presence of a ghost. When placed in the ghost's favorite room and the ghost interacts with it, the cross will flip upside down
{{wiki_headlight_p1}}: A headlamp that can be worn on the player's head, providing hands-free lighting
{{wiki_lighter_p1}}: A classic lighter that is needed to light candles and the Obsidian Shield
{{wiki_storage_p1}}: A small crate that allows a player to transport multiple items at once
{{wiki_rempod_p1}}: A small device that emits a EMF to increase paranormal activity. Lights on the top of the device will illuminate as the ghost gets closer to the device
{{wiki_candle_p1}}: A basic candle that can be used to indicate paranormal activity if a ghost decides to blow out the flame
{{wiki_motion1_p1}}: A wireless motion sensor that can be placed in a room to detect movement. When the ghost moves within range of the device, the lights on the top of the device will illuminate and data will be visible in the Phantom Detect app
{{wiki_motion2_p1}}: A laser motion sensor that can be placed in a room to detect movement. When the ghost or player breaks the laser beam, the lights on the top of the device will illuminate and data will be visible in the Phantom Detect app
{{wiki_eal_p1}}: A device only useful in Cleanse, that can be used to locate paranormal relics. When nearby the ghostly light will begin to flash
